title: Harmonious Argentinian Pork Stir-fry
description: A resinous and snappy solo-dinner dish from Argentina featuring orange zest in a mushimono-steamed preparation with no onion or garlic.

ingredients.name: Pork loin
ingredients.notes: boneless and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat a wok or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add pork cubes and sear until golden brown on all sides.
Remove pork from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add orange zest and cook for about 1 minute.
Pour in water, soy sauce, brown sugar, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Return pork to the pan, cover, and simmer for 5 minutes or until juices run clear.
Serve hot as a solo-dinner dish.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
